plannedSets.description: What the plan asks for, one entry per set. A list rather than a count plus a shared config: "fixed / range / per set" is an authoring convenience, and display collapses equal targets back to "4 × 10" for free.

supersetWithNext.description: When true, this exercise is performed back-to-back with the following one (a superset), with no rest in between.

link.description: A url to some explanation of how to do this. We should not fill this unless the user has explicitly given us a link to fill

loadBasis.description:
Where this movement's load comes from, and whether it has one at all.

- `external` - a plain weighted movement; the stored weight is the whole load.
- `bodyweight` - the base load is the lifter's own bodyweight (pull-ups, dips) and each set's   stored weight is the *added* load on top of it: positive when weighted, negative when assisted.
- `none` - the exercise does not track a load at all (crunches). Nothing renders a weight,   nothing sums a volume, nothing computes a 1RM, because there is no value to render.
